notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 8.
description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least eight {U}.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {5}{U}, causing you to draw a card and return Whispers of the Muse to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Nykthos.
Repeat.
